title: Ankans Decorations
description: Decorations mod, adds a bunch of different blocks that can be used in building
body:
# ABOUT:
Ankans Decorations is a decorative building mod that adds a wide variety of detailed furniture and props, including chairs, tables, and more to enhance your builds and bring them to life. All blocks are designed to fit into the vanilla style while still adding variety to your builds!

# LIST OF BLOCKS:
- Wooden Chairs (Oak, Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, Dark oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Bamboo, Crimson and Warped)
- Small Tables (Oak, Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, Dark oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Bamboo, Crimson and Warped)
- Placable Bottles
- Oak Panels
- Bedside Lamps
- Floor Lamps
- 1x1 Window Frames (Oak, Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, Dark oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Bamboo, Crimson and Warped)
- 2x2 Window Frame (Oak, Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, Dark oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Bamboo, Crimson and Warped)
- Radiators
- Couch/Sofa
- Tables (Oak, Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, Dark oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Bamboo, Crimson and Warped)
- TV
- Ceiling Lamp
- Livingroom Bench

  MORE TO COME!

# CREDITS:
This mod was developed using [Mcreator](https://mcreator.net/). Huge thanks to the developers for providing such an accessible modding tool.
